name: Hayama Hinano
source:
"Hahaha, wow, a real chikan! I've never seen one before!"

A first year student at Akumegawa Academy. A cheerful, lively gyaru who is always smiling. She loves sex. She has practically no sense of chastity, and will have sex with any man she likes right away. Her cheerful personality has earned her many friends, both male and female.

She boasts of her beautiful face and lewd body that she inherits from her mother. Because of her appearance, which is out of place for her age, she is often mistaken for a university student or a working adult.

She usually works part-time at a theme cafe in the downtown area. Lately she's been hooked to the anime Cure Bitch from "Hamedorianus☆Puni Cure," which airs on Sunday mornings. She always watches it with her younger brother, who is much younger than her.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara2]official website[/url]]
